content.text: How we are handling payments right now shawty?

We’re using **Kernel’s native card-payment flow, shawty — with private approval for each purchase.**

1. Clanker reads the checkout items and total. Current limit: **₹500, INR, India**.
2. You get a private review link to approve that purchase and choose whether to remember your card. Kernel handles payment credentials; Clanker keeps metadata.
3. After approval, dedicated tools fill the card and submit once. Bank OTP, if required, goes through private collection.
4. A Pay click isn’t success. Clanker requires a merchant receipt with **paid status, matching amount, and order ID**. Uncertain submissions aren’t automatically retried.

A real merchant payment remains unverified.** Some README/setup text still says payments are unavailable, so the docs are inconsistent. content.text:
**No—the same payment card cannot be used after 10 hours.** The request expires **15 minutes after creation**, even if unopened.

- TTL: [store.py:163](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/store.py:163) sets payment expiry to `now + 900`.
- Clicking expired card: [web.py:141](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/web.py:141) checks expiry before showing the form; [store.py:176](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/store.py:176) returns HTTP 410.
- Visible outcome: [vault.js:306](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/vault.js:306) shows **“Link no longer available”** and directs the user back to Slack for a new link.
- Purchase execution also rejects expiry: [payments.py:422](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/payments.py:422) for card fill and [card_payments.py:151](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/card_payments.py:151) for submit.
- No automatic refresh: [payments.py:315](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/payments.py:315) stops polling expired requests.

Recovery caveat: An untouched request remains in `review`, so a fresh payment request is permitted by [card_payments.py:63](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/card_payments.py:63). If enrollment/approval progressed before expiry, an unresolved purchase blocks another request until cancelled/reconciled. Cancellation handles an unsubmitted purchase at [payments.py:509](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/runtime/vault/payments.py:509).

Suggested concise user wording: “No, shawty—the current payment link expires after **15 minutes**. After 10 hours, it’ll show **‘Link no longer available.’** Tell Clanker **‘continue the purchase and send me a fresh payment link’**; the old card won’t resume the payment automatically.”
